title: LibreSprite Round 09 verified four-layer three-frame static editing and art critique
summary: GitHub Actions run 42962709703 succeeded: LibreSprite 1.3 opened a public-safe generic 72x112 native RGBA practice ASE containing internal_structure, faceted_armor, drapery and signals layers over three frames, edited actual cels via JS and exported ASE, PNG sheet, JSON metadata and GIF. Validator passed stable feet y=101..111, no partial alpha, 14 colors including transparency. Independent parse of exported source and edited ASE verified all named layers, exact matching PNG composites and 14/15/16 source-to-editor pixel changes across frames 0/1/2 without modifying alpha. This is technically reproducible but VISUAL QUALITY FAILED: figure stiff, angular armor simplistic, helmet and materials lack refined character design. Continue actual editorial practice, not generic effects or premature game production.

reviews.evidence: Scope LIMITED TO TECHNICAL PIPELINE: GitHub Actions run 42962709703 all steps completed success; artifact 13829208463 contained 4-layer 3-frame ASE, editor-exported 216x112 sprite sheet and GIF. Independent parser checked native layer names, composite pixel equivalence to exported PNGs, 14/15/16 source-to-edited pixel mutations, unmodified alpha masks, stationary ground y=101..111. This DOES NOT imply character-art quality passed; study explicitly marks visual quality FAILED.
